data.exact_reserve_text: The profit on the technical account of GBP 38.9m (2017: loss GBP 23.6m) includes a run-off surplus of GBP 44.0m for prior accident years (2017: GBP 8.0m deficit). This included a surplus of GBP 17.3m for reinsurance acceptance business and a surplus of GBP 26.7m on direct business (2017: deficit of GBP 8.8m for reinsurance acceptance business and a surplus of GBP 0.8m on direct business).
data.standardized_narrative: The gross claims development triangle analysis (gross cumulative incurred claims) indicates a net adverse movement (strengthening) on prior underwriting years (2011-2016) of approximately GBP 24.8m (3.0% of opening gross claims outstanding). However, the managing agent's narrative reports a run-off surplus of GBP 44.0m for prior accident years (split into GBP 17.3m surplus on reinsurance acceptance business and GBP 26.7m surplus on direct business) - that narrative figure appears to be a net (after reinsurance) measure. The numerical prior-year movement reported here is derived from the gross claims development table; the narrative release appears to be net of reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount provided here is derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative incurred claims). The managing agent narrative reports a run-off surplus of GBP 44.0m for prior accident years; that narrative figure appears to be net of reinsurance and therefore differs in sign and magnitude from the gross triangle-derived movement (+GBP 24.8m adverse). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' single-line figure was found in the notes; therefore the triangle was used (per instructions). Lob-level prior-year movements are not provided; lob movement reported as aggregate only.
